checks.title: Confirm site and growth goal
checks.instructions: Confirm the owner controls or is authorized to assess the website, its canonical URL, the offer, target buyers, geography, and one primary visitor action. Save stable decisions in MEMORY.md.

checks.title: Verify the growth skill
checks.instructions: Confirm skills/website-growth-starter/SKILL.md exists and website-growth-starter is selected for this Crew. Preserve any other installed skills.

checks.title: Inspect the website
checks.instructions: Verify that public site pages or an owner-provided export are readable. Record the inspected URLs and crawl limits. Do not infer indexing status from a public page fetch.

checks.title: Define useful traffic
checks.instructions: Agree on buyer questions, the target audience, and which visitor action matters. Record assumptions that still need validation.

checks.title: Record a starting baseline
checks.instructions: Use an authorized Search Console or analytics export if available, with property and date range. For a new site without enough data, explicitly record the baseline as unavailable and the date from which measurement will start. A connection is not required.

checks.title: Verify the first site audit
checks.instructions: Inspect representative pages and produce source-linked findings about discoverability, content, and the primary conversion path. Label unverified hypotheses.

checks.title: Review the 30-day plan
checks.instructions: Present a prioritized 30-day plan with three to five actions, evidence, effort, owner, and success signal. Complete after the owner reviews and agrees on the first actions.

checks.title: Decide how page changes ship
checks.instructions: Ask whether Crew should only draft changes in chat or use an authorized repository/CMS for reviewable edits. Chat-only is a valid completed choice. Do not publish or grant access as part of installing the template.

checks.title: Decide on measurement cadence
checks.instructions: Ask whether the owner wants a weekly review or a new-page trigger. Choosing neither is valid. If requested, agree on data source, timezone or event source, and test one run before enabling.

checks.title: Decide on broader growth automation
checks.instructions: Ask whether a separate goal-chasing Website Growth Loop Automation or a typed site_audit function would be useful to other Crews. Choosing neither is valid. Review permissions and metrics before creating either.
